It has such natural beauty and serene landscapes that still feel untouched — and honestly, the lesser the crowd, the more peaceful and clean it remains. Visiting the Rann was an unforgettable experience. Even though it wasn’t fully white this time due to weather conditions, we still enjoyed the “white desert” completely. Driving through what truly felt like “the road to heaven” was magical — so calm, so beautiful.
Another highlight of our trip was chasing sunsets — we witnessed almost four sunsets, and each one was spectacular. A big thank-you to our driver, who made sure we never missed them. His support, timing, and friendly attitude added a lot to our experience.
Overall, we are very grateful for your excellent service. This trip became one of our most memorable travel experiences because of your planning and effort. Please keep up the great work — and I’m already looking forward to more trips with you in the future.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Our 13-day journey with TravelEscapes was nothing short of extraordinary, breathtaking, and truly unforgettable. From the very beginning till the end, every moment was filled with adventure, comfort, excitement, and countless beautiful memories that we will cherish forever.

Our trip started from the mesmerizing hills of Shimla, followed by the scenic beauty of Kalpa, and then towards the magical landscapes of Kaza. During our journey, we unfortunately faced a sudden landslide situation and had to stay overnight in Nako. In such a challenging and unexpected situation, the Founder and Co-Founder themselves were travelling with us and personally ensured that every single arrangement was perfectly managed. Their calmness, dedication, hospitality, and constant support made us feel completely safe and secure even in such a remote and lonely location. That level of care and responsibility is truly rare and highly commendable.

After that, we had an incredibly lavish, comfortable, and relaxing stay in Kaza which added even more charm to our journey. Later, while heading towards our next destination, Mcleodganj, the team thoughtfully understood that travelling directly from Kaza to Mcleodganj for almost 20 straight hours would be extremely tiring. To make the trip smoother, more comfortable, and stress-free, TravelEscapes arranged a wonderful overnight stay in the beautiful town of Narkanda. This thoughtful gesture clearly reflected their professionalism and genuine concern for every traveller’s comfort.

The next afternoon, we finally reached Mcleodganj, which turned out to be one of the absolute highlights of our trip. The vibe, the views, the atmosphere, the fun moments, and the delicious dinner experience there were simply exceptional and memorable beyond words.

Our final destination was the vibrant and soulful city of Amritsar, which perfectly concluded this incredible adventure.

A huge and heartfelt thank you to Lucky Paaji, Bhavesh Jain, and Veer Jain for accompanying us throughout the journey, constantly helping us, guiding us, supporting us, and making us feel safe, comfortable, and cared for in every possible situation.

TravelEscapes is not just a travel company — it is an experience filled with warmth, trust, adventure, luxury, and unforgettable memories. Highly recommended to everyone looking for a safe, professionally managed, exciting, and truly memorable travel experience.

Tour Manager: While the Tour Manager was friendly and knowledgeable about the sites, we felt rushed through some of the key attractions. Unfortunately, more time was spent at shops recommended by him (which were not part of the local markets), which could have been avoided.

Food: For non-vegetarians, it was a true delight with Türkiye’s famous kebabs and sweets. However, vegetarian options were quite limited, though Indian restaurants offering vegetarian food were available.

Overall: It was an exciting trip, and we thoroughly enjoyed every moment!
